Backtest playback and replay validation with shred buffering, bank hash checks, and tower updates.

# Purpose
This file defines the `backt` tile for backtest playback. It connects to backtest RocksDB data, reads shreds and bank hashes for a slot range, and feeds replay and tower outputs so the system can run a backtest flow. The tile waits for snapshot load or genesis start before it begins replay processing, which avoids a race between snapshot setup and replay input. It also tracks timing data and stops the process when the configured end slot is reached.

The main logic is in [`before_credit`](<#before_credit>), [`after_credit`](<#after_credit>), and [`returnable_frag`](<#returnable_frag>), which are the stem callbacks used to control fragment flow. [`before_credit`](<#before_credit>) reads shreds and bank hashes from `fd_backtest_rocksdb_t` into local buffers. [`after_credit`](<#after_credit>) writes shred payloads into `fd_store_t`, detects FEC set completion, and publishes synthetic FEC-complete fragments on `shred_out`. [`returnable_frag`](<#returnable_frag>) handles snapshot, genesis, and replay inputs, initializes state, checks replay bank hashes against stored hashes, publishes `fd_tower_slot_done_t` messages on `tower_out`, and ends the run when the final slot is processed. The file also defines tile setup code, scratch layout, input and output link binding, and the exported `fd_tile_backtest` run descriptor.
